notes: Fingerprint / face unlock (Android, experimental, optional): unlock the app and reveal Secret Morse with your fingerprint. Android's secure hardware checks it and only then releases a key locked to it; Vexunori never sees your fingerprint. Your PIN or passphrase always works too. It never opens a hidden profile, and adding a new fingerprint to the phone switches it off until you turn it on again with your PIN. Turning Secret Morse protection off still needs your PIN or passphrase.

Vault export files (.vxvault) and protected Spaces now use Argon2id too. Old export files still import, and existing protected Spaces upgrade the first time you unlock them. Export files made with 1.3.0 cannot be opened by older versions.
Export passphrases must now be strong (strength meter).
New Android permissions from the fingerprint library: USE_BIOMETRIC and USE_FINGERPRINT (normal, no prompt).
Still experimental and untested on many real phones — please report bugs on GitHub.
